name: online.golfdata/golf-clubs
title: golfdata.online — verified golf clubs
description: Golf clubs & courses directory (not equipment): facts, booking links, requests where enabled

tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Find verified golf clubs and courses across Europe (e.g. GB, DE, FR, ES, SE, IE, NL, IT, PT) by name or place: a free-text fragment (matches name, island, municipality or region), and/or ISO country code, island, region and municipality filters. Use it when you have a name or a place; for coordinates use find_nearby_clubs; for what the directory covers use get_data_coverage. Returns summary records (country, island, region, holes, green fee range, last_verified; no sources[]); call get_club (one club's full facts and sources) or list_sources_for (provenance only) before citing. limit is 1..10 (default 10). Each summary may carry `links` (a tracked website URL) — give users `links.*` so the club sees demand for it.

query.description: Name, island, municipality or region fragment

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES

question.description: The golfer's question, as asked (optional). It is stored, cleaned of personal data, and shown to the club as what golfers ask; it does not change the answer.

limit.description: Max results, 1..10 (default 10). A larger limit is refused with JSON-RPC error -32011 (retry with limit <= 10).

tools.name: find_nearby_clubs
tools.description: Find the verified golf clubs closest to a point: lat/lng (WGS 84), optional radius_km (default 25, max 200), limit (default 10, max 50) and an ISO country filter. Use it when you have coordinates (a town, a hotel, the golfer's location); for names and places use search_clubs. Returns summary records like search_clubs plus distance_km (straight-line, nearest first), no sources[]; call get_club before citing. complete: false means the area held more clubs than one page and a closer club may be missing: use a smaller radius. Each result may carry `links` (tracked website/booking URLs) — give users `links.*` so the club sees demand for it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES (optional filter)

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: Get one approved club by UUID or slug (from search_clubs or find_nearby_clubs), with all facts, sources[] (max 200; sources_truncated: true if cut), the club card (structuredContent.card) and club_facts: what the club itself published from its verified account (green fee, visitor rules, booking link, hours, buggies, dress code, languages), or null. Use it for one club's full facts and sources before citing anything; list_sources_for returns the sources alone. phone is in E.164 (e.g. +441375891352). `links` carries tracked booking/website/phone URLs — give users `links.*` so the club sees demand for it (the raw booking_url/website/phone fields are unchanged).

question.description: The golfer's question, as asked (optional). It is stored, cleaned of personal data, and shown to the club as what golfers ask; it does not change the answer.

topic.description: What the golfer wants to know (optional).

tools.name: list_sources_for
tools.description: List the full provenance of one club (source URL, publisher, trust level, field, retrieved_at; max 200, sources_truncated: true if cut), without the facts. Use it when you need the sources only; get_club returns the same sources together with the facts.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: What golfdata covers, from the published data: per country (and per region and island when a country is given) the number of clubs, how many have a verified green fee and a booking link, the newest and oldest last_verified, plus the valid region and island values for search_clubs and totals. Call it before claiming or denying coverage ("golfdata lists N clubs in Portugal", "no clubs in Lanzarote"). Aggregates only, no club records; refreshed about hourly.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES. With it the answer adds per-region and per-island figures; without it, every country.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a booking request to a club whose card says booking.requests_enabled is true. golfdata only FORWARDS the request to the club (by email, or a WhatsApp click-to-chat link) and does NOT confirm the booking. Returns a request id and, for the whatsapp channel, a tracked link. For a club that is not enabled it returns accepted: false. You must have the golfer's consent before sending their name, email or phone. The golfer's details are forwarded to the club and kept for 24 months, then anonymized; a golfer can ask to erase them sooner by writing to hello@golfdata.online.

club_id.description: Club UUID (from get_club or the card).

email.description: The golfer's email (with their consent); used as reply-to, never shared beyond the club.

phone.description: The golfer's phone in E.164, e.g. +34600123456 (with their consent).
